description: Gostman in VS Code: send requests from their files and run your API collections, with their checks, in the Test Explorer. The free, open source API client for REST, GraphQL, gRPC and WebSocket.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Running a collection sends requests and runs its scripts.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: The extension starts the Gostman command line, which reads the collection from a local folder.
command.runFolder: Gostman: Run a folder of the collection
command.scan: Gostman: Scan the collection for leaked secrets
command.init: Gostman: Create a collection in this folder
config.path: Command that starts the Gostman CLI. Use a full path when `gostman` is neither on the PATH nor in `GOBIN`, `GOPATH/bin` or `~/go/bin`.
config.environment: Environment name passed as `--env` for collections where no environment was chosen with **Gostman: Select environment** or the status bar item. Empty uses the first environment of the collection.
view.requests.empty:

color.success: Gostman: colour of GET, HEAD and OPTIONS requests.
color.warning: Gostman: colour of POST, PUT and PATCH requests.
color.info: Gostman: colour of gRPC, MCP and WebSocket requests.
